findings.body:
The diff removes the `samples.is_empty()` early return. For an empty slice, `total` is 0 and `samples.len() as u32` is 0, so the expression becomes integer `0 / 0`, which panics. The doc comment on line 1 promises 0 when there are no samples.

Trigger: Calling average(&[]) with an empty slice.','trigger_placeholder':'' ,

Impact: Any caller that passes an empty slice gets a panic instead of the documented 0. Because `average` is `pub`, external crates can reach this path, and no in-repo caller was found to confirm it.
findings.suggestion: Restore the empty-slice guard: `if samples.is_empty() { return 0; }`.
findings.title: average() panics with division by zero on empty input

risk_level.reason: The diff removes the empty-slice guard, so average() now panics with division by zero on empty input, contradicting its documented return of 0.
